analysis.summary: In Q2 and H1 FY27, Krishana Phoschem Limited achieved its highest-ever half-yearly financial performance, supported by operational efficiency and favorable Nutrient Based Subsidy policy rates. Q2 FY27 revenue from operations reached ₹703 crore, up 16% YoY, while profit after tax surged 135% YoY to ₹78 crore. The company expects second-half revenue to improve and EBITDA margins to normalize to around 13% as market conditions stabilize. Krishana Phoschem Limited reported its highest-ever half-yearly performance in H1 FY27, with Q2 FY27 revenue from operations rising 16% YoY to ₹703 crore and PAT increasing 135% YoY to ₹78 crore. EBITDA margins in H1 FY27 were supported by favorable Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) rates announced by the Government of India.

guidance.claim: The company believes achieving its full-year turnover target should not be very difficult.
guidance.quote: However, considering our track record, marketing capabilities, sales team, and network of wholesalers and traders, we believe achieving the target should not be very difficult.

guidance.claim: Management expects second-half turnover to be better.
guidance.quote: Our second half turnover will be better.

guidance.claim: The company expects to maintain an EBITDA margin of around 13% in the second half.
guidance.quote: We expect to maintain an EBITDA margin of around 13% in the second half.

guidance.claim: The company expects to maintain average EBITDA margins in the range of 12% to 13%.
guidance.quote: We expect to maintain our average EBITDA margin in the range of 12%–13%.

demand_outlook.claim: The domestic fertilizer industry experienced uneven monsoon distribution and cautious dealer restocking during Q2 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: The domestic fertilizer industry navigated a mixed operating environment during Q2 FY27 with uneven monsoon distribution, cautious dealer restocking and changing crop nutrition preferences influencing NPK demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Farmers heavily favored DAP and urea during the Kharif season due to price gaps.
demand_outlook.quote: During the Kharif season, price gaps led farmers to heavily favor DAP and urea resulting in imbalanced soil nutrient profiles.

demand_outlook.claim: Government subsidy support is prompting farmers to shift towards balanced NPK grades in the Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving affordability, backed by strong government subsidy support, is now prompting farmers to shift towards balanced NPK Grades during Rabi season to restore soil health.

demand_outlook.claim: Uneven rainfall in agricultural regions affected Kharif sowing and moderated fertilizer consumption in phosphatic and potassic segments.
demand_outlook.quote: Uneven rainfall in the agricultural regions affected Kharif sowing and moderated fertilizer consumption, particularly in the phosphatic and potassic segments.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects demand from wholesalers to support the achievement of its targeted sales.
demand_outlook.quote: We expect demand from wholesalers to support us in achieving our targets.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has not planned any capacity expansion in the SSP segment so far.
capex_expansion.quote: No, we have not planned any capacity expansion in the SSP segment so far.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's NPK and DAP capacity expansion has already been implemented.
capex_expansion.quote: The NPK/DAP capacity expansion has already been implemented.

capex_expansion.claim: The management is actively evaluating expansion opportunities across industrial chemicals and new geographies.
capex_expansion.quote: Simultaneously, we are actively evaluating expansion opportunities across industrial chemicals and new geographies to diversify our growth engines.

capex_expansion.claim: Management is evaluating projects and will present a final proposal once the evaluation is complete.
capex_expansion.quote: The management is currently evaluating certain projects, and we will present a final proposal at the appropriate time once the evaluation is complete.

margins_costs.claim: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin improved to 18% compared to 12% in Q2 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA: Surged 74% YoY to ₹127 crore, with EBITDA margin improving to 18% from 12% in Q2 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Global fertilizer markets face input cost pressures and supply chain uncertainties.
margins_costs.quote: On the global front, fertilizer markets continue to grapple with input cost pressures and supply chain uncertainties.

margins_costs.claim: The higher EBITDA in H1 FY27 was primarily driven by NBS rates announced by the government.
margins_costs.quote: This is primarily due to the Nutrient-Based Subsidy (NBS) rates announced by the Government of India and made applicable during the period.

margins_costs.claim: Normal EBITDA margins for the company typically range between 12% and 13%.
margins_costs.quote: Otherwise, our normal EBITDA margin would be in the range of 12%–13%.

margins_costs.claim: Phosphoric acid and sulfur international prices remained elevated while ammonia prices softened slightly.
margins_costs.quote: Regarding international raw material prices, phosphoric acid and sulfur remained elevated while ammonia prices softened slightly and rock phosphate stayed broadly stable.

margins_costs.claim: Input cost trends were mixed in H1 FY27, with elevated sulphur and phosphoric acid prices, slightly softened ammonia prices, and stable rock phosphate prices.
margins_costs.quote: Input cost trends remained mixed during the period, with sulphur and phosphoric acid prices elevated, while ammonia prices softened slightly and rock phosphate prices remained broadly stable.

margins_costs.claim: H1 FY27 EBITDA increased by 56% YoY to ₹216 crore, while PAT reached an all-time high of ₹125 crore.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 56% year-on-year to ₹216 crore, while profit after tax reached an all-time high of ₹125 crore, growing 96% year-on-year, reflecting disciplined execution, operational efficiency and resilient business fundamentals.

margins_costs.claim: The government approved ₹62,370 crore under the Nutrient Based Subsidy scheme for the Rabi 2026–27 season.
margins_costs.quote: The Government's approval of ₹62,370 crore under the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) scheme for the Rabi 2026–27 season provides policy support to the fertiliser sector and reinforces the focus on maintaining nutrient availability and affordability for farmers.

orders_capacity.claim: Fertilizer production reached 1,81,906 metric tonnes with sales of 1,70,783 metric tonnes during H1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Volumes: Fertiliser production stood at 1,81,906 metric tonnes, with sales of 1,70,783 metric tonnes.

orders_capacity.claim: The company aims to maintain NPK and DAP capacity utilization in the range of 70% to 80%.
orders_capacity.quote: For NPK/DAP, depending on market conditions, demand, sulphuric acid prices and other factors, we will try to maintain a reasonable capacity utilisation level, which may be in the range of 70%–80%.

orders_capacity.claim: Around 35% to 40% of the complex fertilizer market in India is served by overseas suppliers.
orders_capacity.quote: Around 35%–40% of the market is still served by overseas suppliers.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates at peak capacity utilization in SSP and sees headroom to scale its manufactured NPK business.
orders_capacity.quote: With peak capacity utilisation in SSP and significant headroom to scale our manufactured NPK business, we are well-positioned to enhance production volumes, improve integration benefits and strengthen our market presence.

capital_allocation.claim: Substantial imports undertaken during the latter part of the half-year led to increased short-term borrowings.
capital_allocation.quote: Particularly during the latter part of the half year, we undertook substantial imports, which led to an increase in borrowings.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's current assets reached an all-time high of ₹1,700 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Our current assets level is also Rs. 1,700 crore. All time high.

capital_allocation.claim: Management highlighted strong operating margins and an efficient working capital cycle.
capital_allocation.quote: Strong operating margins & efficient working capital cycle

risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, geopolitical tensions in West Asia and transit uncertainties around the Strait of Hormuz disrupted international trade flows, driving up freight and insurance costs.

risks_headwinds.quote: With the increase in NPK prices, we have also faced some pressure in pushing our products into the market.

risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions continue to create uncertainty in global commodity markets.
